research.notes: Identity rests on the organization's own website only. The search budget ran out and ProPublica returned HTTP 429, so no registry (IRS, CA SOS, SAM.gov) confirmed the legal name or EIN, and no page cited a direct OUSD relationship. Confidence is medium for that reason; a reviewer should check the EIN and legal name in ProPublica.

profile.summary: Youth ALIVE! is a nonprofit based in Oakland, California. It works to break the cycle of violence, heal trauma, and support young people as community leaders. Its programs include violence prevention workshops led by teens, violence intervention, and counseling and healing services.
